parameters.note: Apple's rating prompt is asked for only once the person has finished at least this many workouts on this phone (K-1254, ADR-095): HIG asks for it only after people have demonstrated engagement.
Never in the first week of use on this phone (HIG: not on first launch or during onboarding).
At least this long between two requests (HIG: a week or two). Apple itself shows the prompt at most three times in 365 days.
The finish screen with a new best is seen first; the request comes this long after it opens, never as the result of a tap (StoreKit: not in response to a user action).
Added to the App Store address (app.config.ts ios.appStoreUrl) for Settings' rate row: Apple's write-review page, the persistent link StoreKit allows in settings.
